intelligence.enrichment: A food chain is a simple linear sequence showing who eats whom in an ecosystem. Food relationships link the eaten organism to the organism that eats it, forming a chain of feeding dependence. The learner correctly applies this rule: A food chain is a simple linear sequence showing who eats whom in an ecosystem. A food chain is any list of organisms from the same picture or habitat.
